integrations.title: Integratsiyalar
integrations.lead: Email yuborish va Google orqali kirish kalitlari. Kalitni shu yerga nusxalab qo‘yasiz — serverga kirish shart emas. Kalitlar shifrlangan holda saqlanadi va qayta ko‘rsatilmaydi.
steps_email: resend.com saytida ro‘yxatdan o‘ting (bepul: oyiga 3000 ta xat).
Domains → Add Domain → {domain} ni qo‘shing. Resend ko‘rsatgan DNS yozuvlarini (MX, TXT) domen panelida qo‘shing va “Verify” ni bosing.
API Keys → Create API Key (Sending access) → kalitni quyidagiga qo‘ying.
steps_google: APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen: External, ilova nomi va emailingizni yozing, “Publish app”.
Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application.
Client ID va Client secret ni quyidagiga qo‘ying.
integrations.notice_yuborildi: Test xat yuborildi — pochtangizni tekshiring (Spam papkasini ham).
integrations.notice_ulanmagan: Email xizmati hali ulanmagan: avval Resend kalitini kiriting.
integrations.notice_xato: Xat yuborilmadi: kalitni va domen tasdiqlanganini (Resend → Domains → Verified) tekshiring.
steps_ai: Billing → kartani ulang va balansni to‘ldiring (masalan, $10). “Auto reload” ni o‘chiq qoldiring — balans tugasa, AI shunchaki sinov rejimiga qaytadi.
Settings → Limits: oylik xarajat chegarasini qo‘ying (masalan, $20).
API Keys → Create Key → kalitni quyidagiga qo‘ying.
Model: Sozlamalar → Xorazmiy AI → ai.model (tejamkor: claude-sonnet-5-5).
